blocks.text: Does it seem like there's never enough space no matter how much you declutter? With the City Box, you get extra storage space to keep things organized outside your home. Whether it's poolside or on your balcony, this resin box provides adequate space for pool supplies, cushions and more. It can even double as extra seating for enjoying a good book outdoors.
